Mean of the unrounded bearings is 105.51 deg. Non-rotating inclination from this pad and azimuth is 31.91 deg. Not an SSO heading. payload_kg.note: FITTED to reach the ASSUMED orbit at the typical vernier cutoff. Payload is unknown (LL2 'Unknown Payload'); the fitted value is NOT an estimate.

insertion_alt_km.assumption: Altitude is NOT published. LL2 orbit is Unknown. 500 km circular is an ASSUMED round LEO altitude, the same stand-in as lm2c-xichang when the orbit was unknown and as the reused Taiyuan LM-2D config. It is not an SSO target: the NOTAM azimuth gives a non-rotating inclination of 31.91 deg, and SSO at 500 km is about 97.4 deg. Not a mission altitude.

header_notes: ILLUSTRATIVE. PRE-FLIGHT. Unknown payload, Long March 2D, Xichang Launch Complex 3 (LC-3/LA-1). LL2 id b00f0e9a-48d6-4f26-9cb5-7d19169ff7c4, last_updated 2026-11-20T09:12:38Z, update 'Added launch per NOTAMs; Payload and launch vehicle identities uncertain.'

Vehicle and stage data reused from the lm2d-taiyuan entry (vehicles/lm2d.json): configuration-2 masses and the SAST TYPICAL sequence via huijiwiki, S1 vacuum via the YF-20 ratio, verniers ASSUMED to run from S2 ignition to 705.1 s, 3.35 m fairing 860 kg ASSUMED, Cd transferred from the LM-3B fit. Event times are the typical sequence, not this flight's. No altitude/range knots are published.

AZIMUTH 105.51 deg from NOTAM Q-line centres (ZPKM A6099/26 104.51 deg, ZGZU A6100/26 106.52 deg). TARGET ASSUMED: 500 km circular. The azimuth is southeast, non-rotating inclination 31.91 deg, so this is not the SSO shell used for the Taiyuan LM-2D. No deploy time is published. VEHICLE IDENTITY: LL2 names Long March 2D and flags the vehicle as uncertain. A Chinese Wikipedia future-launch row lists a Long March 2C to GTO from Xichang on 26 Nov with no clock; that row was not used.

deploy.note: No payload-deploy time is published (LL2 payload and orbit Unknown). The SAST typical sequence lists separation at 737.1 s, but that time is not this flight's, so it is not used.

area_m2.derived: pi x (3.35 m / 2)^2, LM-2D S2 diameter, same derivation as lm2d-taiyuan

notes: Typical-sequence residual-propellant venting after separation is not modelled.
